name: githired
description: Search Canada-eligible technology jobs from employer ATS boards.

interface.longDescription: GitHired exposes a free, read-only remote MCP server for Canada-eligible technology jobs scraped from employer ATS boards (Greenhouse, Lever, Ashby, Workday, and others). Search openings, fetch job detail, match a skill profile deterministically, and view market stats from the tracked dataset. Original employer apply URLs and advertised salaries only — no résumé storage and no invented pay or geography.
defaultPrompt: Find five remote Senior Data Engineer jobs in Canada.
Find Toronto software roles advertising at least CAD $150,000.
Show GitHired market stats for remote data engineering in Ontario.

review.notes: Remote MCP only. No authentication. Tools are read-only with openWorldHint because results reflect live employer ATS data. Support via GitHub Issues on mikegianfelice/GitHired.

positive.prompt: Use GitHired to find remote data engineer jobs in Canada.
positive.expect: Calls search_jobs and returns Canada-eligible listings with apply URLs.

positive.prompt: Use GitHired to get details for a job id returned from search.
positive.expect: Calls get_job with a stable id and returns detail/excerpt.

positive.prompt: Match Python, SQL, and Databricks skills to Canadian data engineering roles.
positive.expect: Calls match_profile and returns ranked relevance scores.

positive.prompt: Show GitHired market stats for remote roles in Ontario.
positive.expect: Calls get_market_stats scoped to province/work arrangement.

positive.prompt: Find Toronto software engineering roles with minimum salary 150000 CAD.
positive.expect: Calls search_jobs with location/salary filters; only advertised salaries.

negative.prompt: Apply to a job on my behalf through GitHired.
negative.expect: Refuses apply automation; GitHired is read-only search.

negative.prompt: Invent a CAD salary for a job that has no advertised pay.
negative.expect: Does not invent compensation; reports missing salary.

negative.prompt: Mark a US-only remote role as Canada-eligible without evidence.
